Descriptions:
A ragged but loyal squadron.
They will not break.

Held together by will more than steel.
Still, they endure.

Veterans of too many wars.
They fight like they have nothing left to lose.

Once scattered, now united.
Purpose binds them.
Outnumbered, outgunned, but never outmatched in spirit.

A fleet built from survivors.
Every ship has a story.

They were not meant to last this long.
Yet here they are.

Scarred hulls, steady hands.
They know how to win ugly.
A force that refuses extinction.
They carry the weight of every system they've lost.

A static defense force.
They hold their ground but will not advance.
A holdover from a more glorious time
Hardly more than brigands

Their purpose is simple.
Hold the line.
Mearly decked out miners and farmers
Cornered and scared, but will not og down without a last fight.
A forgotten defence brigade

They do not seek conflict.
But they will answer it.
A lone planetary defenceforce. No match for us.

Positioned to defend what matters.
Nothing more.
They stand watch over a quiet sky.
A remnant of a former great power
Few they are, but ready to take up arms to defend their homes.
A forgotten corner of the galaxy.
A Young system, untouched.

Sparse and quiet.
Travelers rarely stay long.
A crossroads that lost its purpose.
Once vital, now abandoned to time.
Signals echo here longer than they should.

Navigation is unreliable.
Charts contradict each other.

A region shaped by old conflicts.
The scars remain.
Few resources, fewer allies.
It sits on the edge of relevance.
What happens here is rarely recorded.
An empty stretch that still feels watched.
Routes pass through, but nothing stays.

Barren but rich in minerals.

Once inhabited.
Now only ruins remain.
A mining world stripped to its bones.
Cold, distant, and unforgiving.

There are signs of life.
None are recent.
It offers resources at a cost few can afford.
The ground itself resists change.
Colonies spring up fast here.

Nothing grows.
Everything erodes.
A world that feels abandoned, even when occupied.
